# HexPiece 3.2.9

Nika fruit (Gear 5) rework, part 6: Star Gun's struck body is rubber now. Not tested in game yet: the build and all tests pass, and the
body was rendered through the whole hit (docs/gifs/nika-star-gun-rubber-3.2.9.gif).

**Star Gun (X with Haki on in Gear 5)**
- The body it hits is pushed further: smacked out to about three times its length along the blow (it was 2.35) and pushed back
  with it, the top of the body left behind for a moment by the smack.
- It stays alive while it is held stretched: the top whips forward past its lean and sways, and the whole body quivers and pulses
  like a rubber band instead of standing still.
- When it lets go, the body snaps back past its own shape into a squash (short, wide and tall), springs out again and wobbles to rest.
- Heavier targets (knockback resistance) still bend less, as before. Damage and knockback are unchanged.
